testCases.name: Senior Full-Stack Developer vs Frontend-Leaning Resume

evidenceSentences.Docker: Experience with Docker and containerized deployments is required.
evidenceSentences.PostgreSQL: Strong proficiency in relational database architecture using PostgreSQL is required.
evidenceSentences.AWS: Hands-on experience deploying scalable cloud services on AWS is required.
evidenceSentences.CI/CD: Familiarity with automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions is preferred.

testCases.name: Cloud DevOps Engineer vs Systems Admin
testCases.description: Tests multi-column layout extraction, Kubernetes, Terraform, and cloud platform verification.

evidenceSentences.Kubernetes: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating production workloads on Kubernetes (K8s) is mandatory.
evidenceSentences.Terraform: Proven track record managing Infrastructure as Code via Terraform is required.
evidenceSentences.AWS: Deep operational knowledge of AWS networking, VPC, and IAM policies is required.

testCases.name: Backend Python / AI Engineer vs Data Analyst
testCases.description: Tests Fast API, Redis, Machine Learning, and Unit Testing evidence.

evidenceSentences.FastAPI: High proficiency building asynchronous microservices with FastAPI is required.
evidenceSentences.PostgreSQL: Solid understanding of relational database schema design in PostgreSQL is required.
evidenceSentences.Redis: Experience leveraging Redis for distributed caching and session caching is required.
evidenceSentences.Docker: Must have experience packaging services inside Docker containers.
evidenceSentences.Unit Testing: Rigorous commitment to Unit Testing and TDD using PyTest or Jest is required.
